bio: Sensa unveils a warm, natural vibe, which is enhanced by large picture windows overlooking the glorious countryside. The terrace is taken by storm come sunny weather. The elegant restaurant of the luxury Anatura hotel will take your tastebuds on a whirlwind tour from east to west. You may start with steamed gyoza stuffed with langoustine, leeks and just a hint of lemongrass, while a kimchi sauce with grilled sesame seeds adds umami. How about a vol-au-vent for a main, or a juicy hanger steak expertly grilled on a parilla and paired with a pepper sauce laced in vintage whisky? Thrilling and beautifully nuanced fusion cuisine....
